mentions.name: OneBusAway transit API server
mentions.description: A new transit API server from the OneBusAway project; a blog post walks through the basics of setting it up with Bay Area transit data, with operator data for other locations available via Transit.land.

mentions.name: Maglev
mentions.description: An open source Golang server that can power realtime transit apps. It is one of the open source projects underlying OneBusAway Cloud, and a blog post explains how to set it up with Bay Area transit data.
mentions.source_excerpt: All of this depends on a bunch of really cool open source projects we’re building, like Maglev, a Golang server that can power realtime transit apps. I wrote up a blog post explaining how to set it up here: https://opentransitsoftwarefoundation.org/2026/04/setting-up-maglev-bay-area-transit-data/
